_evidence: 0x0040fa3b calls 0x0040fa51 when byte [0x0095404e] == 0xff, then clears it; 0x0040fa51 calls 0x0040fa6f for each of the 22 car records (0x0066fef0 + k*0x41c). 0x0040fa6f tests record byte +0x7c (sign bit, then bit 0x40 when byte [0x007aafd4] is nonzero), picks the word [0x0066d8b6] or [0x0066d8b4], merges its low 7 bits into byte +0x78 and, unless +0xe6 bit 3 is set, sets +0x78 bit 5. The record bytes +0x78, +0x7c, +0xe6 (zero in the image, game state) vary over the full u8 range (each tested bit set in half of the records); the selector bytes take both sides of their tests. Nothing forms a pointer, so nothing can fault.
